title: Art. 9.14 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, B. Advance Passenger Information (API), 9.14
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States should refrain from imposing fines and penalties on aircraft operators for any errors caused by a systems failure which may have resulted in the transmission of no, or corrupted, data to the public authorities in accordance with API systems.
